milestones.title: Sprint 0 – Product Freeze
milestones.description: Establish MVP scopes, FRD/PRD outlines, and core architectural diagrams.

milestones.description: Implement authentication, RBAC authorization, and database CRUD models for Doctors & Hospitals.

milestones.title: Sprint 2 – Realtime Platform

milestones.title: Sprint 3 – Unified Calendar

milestones.title: Sprint 4 – Emergency Coordination
milestones.description: Create Code Blue SOS alerts, automated escalations, and notification adapters.

milestones.title: Sprint 5 – Adaptive Matching Engine
milestones.description: Formulate routing scores, Google Maps integrations, and transit simulators.

milestones.title: Sprint 6 – UX Polish
milestones.description: Implement skeleton loaders, responsive screen designs, and transitions.

milestones.title: Sprint 7 – Judge Demo
milestones.description: Optimize walkthrough slides, simulation parameters, and scripts for DevHack evaluation.

milestones.title: Sprint 8 – Production Readiness

milestones.title: Sprint 9 – Hospital Pilot

epics.title: Epic: Product Strategy
epics.objective: Design system specifications, user workflows, and structural bounds for the SETU platform.
epics.successMetrics: Clear project documentation signed off by architectural leads, accelerating developer velocity by 30%.

epics.title: Epic: Doctor Management
epics.objective: Build backend and frontend clinician administration panels, active shift trackers, and reliability calculations.
epics.successMetrics: Accurate, real-time tracking of doctor location and availability status, with status changes sync'd across dashboards in <500ms.

epics.title: Epic: Hospital Operations
epics.objective: Design multi-site dashboards, department care capacities, and regional coordination routing thresholds.
epics.successMetrics: Successful multi-tenant data separation, allowing hospital admins to manage local clinics and configure escalation parameters.

epics.title: Epic: Unified Calendar
epics.objective: Develop consolidated scheduler interfaces, calendar sync databases, travel buffer offsets, and conflict detection services.
epics.successMetrics: Double-bookings eliminated across the network, with travel buffers automatically injected between multi-site bookings.

epics.title: Epic: Emergency Coordination
epics.objective: Construct emergency SOS dispatchers, automated alert check loops, consultation selectors, and pager alert triggers.
deliverables: Notification adapters (vibration, SMS, and backup voice calls)
epics.successMetrics: Emergency response time reduced to under 5 minutes through automated dispatching, with fallback escalations triggering within 30s.

epics.title: Epic: Adaptive Matching Engine
epics.objective: Formulate multi-parameter ranking, explainability components, commute calculations, and clinical ratings.
epics.successMetrics: Clinician matching recommendations calculate in under 100ms, providing operators with detailed explanations for rankings.

epics.title: Epic: Navigation & Maps
epics.objective: Integrate interactive mapping libraries, calculate transit paths, and simulate coordinate progress.
epics.successMetrics: Interactive maps rendering dynamically, showing accurate coordinate updates and ETA tracking during simulated transits.

epics.title: Epic: Realtime Platform
epics.objective: Integrate client websocket packages, build channel broadcast gateways, and connect live status updates.
epics.successMetrics: Persistent websocket connections established, sync'ing status changes and alerts across endpoints in <100ms.

epics.title: Epic: Backend & Security
epics.objective: Build session security structures, access control guards, DPDP transaction log tables, and field encryption pipelines.
epics.successMetrics: Total data protection at rest and in transit, with all access attempts recorded in immutable audit tables.

epics.title: Epic: UI / UX
epics.objective: Apply polished design styling, implement loading/empty UI indicators, and adjust mobile responsive layouts.
epics.successMetrics: Aesthetically pleasing, responsive interface that loads without layout shifts and adapts smoothly to tablet and mobile screens.

epics.title: Epic: Judge Demo
epics.objective: Establish presentation control consoles, narrative timeline overlays, script cards, and latency injection overrides.
epics.successMetrics: Seamless, bug-free presentation of the Code Blue workflow, allowing pitch teams to run simulations with one-click controls.

epics.title: Epic: Documentation
epics.objective: Document developer workspace requirements, write swagger specifications, map database model schemas, and design production setup runbooks.
epics.successMetrics: Comprehensive documentation repository enabling fresh developers to clone, configure, and boot the application in <15 minutes.

epics.title: Epic: Startup Integrations
epics.objective: Design metrics analytics portals, layout hospital pilot onboarding playbooks, set maps cost controls, and compile ABDM/FHIR standards gateways.
epics.successMetrics: Commercial readiness established, with compliance documentation and pilot onboarding checklists ready for hospital deployment.

issues.title: Freeze MVP Scope and Icebox Secondary Roadmap Items
issues.overview: Define the boundaries of the SETU Minimum Viable Product (MVP), separating immediate features from secondary roadmap items to focus engineering resources.
issues.problemStatement: Unclear scope boundaries risk resource allocation issues on secondary features (e.g. built-in chat, automatic coordinate billing) rather than core matching reliability.
issues.userStory: As a Product Owner, I want to establish clear MVP boundaries so that the engineering team focuses on delivering a stable emergency coordination core.
technicalRequirements: Define features matrix categorizing MVP vs Icebox items.

acceptanceCriteria: MVP Feature Matrix document committed to repository docs.
Board issues matching non-MVP items labeled as 'status: Blocked' or 'milestone: Sprint 9'.

discussions.title: ADR-001: Selection of Websockets Transport Framework for Realtime Coordinates
discussions.body: This discussion is opened to align on selecting Socket.io over raw WebSockets or MQTT for coordinate updates. Raw websockets require custom heartbeat management, whereas Socket.io offers built-in reconnections. Let us discuss the scalability impacts on server thread load.

discussions.title: Feature: Patient Direct Tele-consultation Join Gateway
discussions.body: Currently the teleconsultation selector is coordinator-driven. Let us discuss introducing a link generator that allows patients to connect directly using WebRTC channels without installing apps.

discussions.title: Standup: Kickoff Sprint 1 and Database Model Alignments
discussions.body: Notes from today's design standup. Agreed to implement JWT sessions and enforce RBAC guards immediately. Action items: @tanish0320 to review schema models and build user sign-up controls.

discussions.title: Pilot Review: Apollo Chennai Desk Integration Obstacles
discussions.body: Feedback from pilot testing. Coordinators noted that triggering SOS alerts requires too many steps when using the wizard. They requested a quick Code Blue button. We need to streamline the layout.

discussions.title: Clinician Review: Location Tracking Battery Drain Warnings
discussions.body: Clinicians flagged coordinate tracking battery drain when apps run in background. We need to implement geofencing filters to stop updates when clinicians are off-duty.

discussions.title: AI: Predictive Traffic ETA Interpolation Routing Engine
discussions.body: Should we integrate traffic predictions instead of static ETAs? Let's discuss training models using historical travel data to adjust dispatch calculations.

discussions.title: Bug: Drag and Drop Calendar overlaps fail check validation
discussions.body: Under low-speed connections, drag events on calendar views can bypass conflict checks. We need to implement transaction blocks on the backend to enforce checks.
